workload.en: B completed 60 runs and 2 repeats, with final hashes identical to the preceding B. All 1,230 fixed comparisons passed. Combining 46 runs before SIGKILL and 14 successful follow-ups with identical code/components, raw metric audit confirms 59 passing free rollouts and failing g08-20261021 (latent nRMSE 0.01758714, RGBA RMSE 0.02754416). Same-input off-trajectory comparisons pass at steps 2/3; source sensitivity dominates there. Separate four-rollout autorelease-pool controls did not resolve Python process memory growth. The distinct DiT group16 candidate is reported separately. No quality, device, or latency acceptance.
workload.ja: Bは60runと2反復を完了し、最終hashは旧Bと一致。固定1,230比較は全合格。SIGKILL前46runと同一code/部品の追試14runを合わせてraw指標を再計算し、自由rollout59件合格、g08-20261021不合格（latent nRMSE 0.01758714、RGBA RMSE 0.02754416）を確認。軌道外step2/3も同入力比較は合格し、その2点では原典の入力感度が支配的。各別processの4rollout対照ではautorelease poolでPythonのメモリ増加は解消しなかった。別IDのDiT group16候補の実測は別記。品質・実機・速度の受入ではない。

workload.en: Ten 512-square, eight-step requests using fixed g02/20261021 generation and e10/20261018 editing inputs and noise. All saved RGBA8/PNG pixels match accepted native outputs; no new latent or unclipped-tensor comparison is claimed. 387,435 memory samples, zero invalid samples, maximum gap 65.097 ms, five-second footprint 98,110,000–122,145,304 bytes. Expanded budgets pass 483 recorded admission points, including separately labeled older controls. Controlled interruption preserves bound journals without a successful result. Low Power Mode was off; transport was wired USB, but charging state and a common-benchmark plan hash were not recorded. Current Models import is separately recorded under source 7eb2a2f; its restart and service connection are pending.
